snippet.title: Super Vadimka II: Revenge of Dr. Kulik - Full Game Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Super Vadimka II: Revenge of Dr. Kulik - horror platformer game created by Kulevx, the sequel to the sad 2021 platformer game Super Vadimka. The main protagonist Super Vadimka returned in the second part to defeat the monster master and the evil Dr. Kulik for the second time.

00:00 The Beginning of A Horror Nightmare.
00:27 The Green Mountain
11:10 Night City
26:26 A Bloody World of Horror
56:38 Sky

01:38:05 The Night Sky
01:54:03 Water
02:23:05 The Desert
02:36:48 Mini Levels
02:47:14 Fortress of Horrors
